requirements: R1: Assign a specific rootCausePatternId to underlying defect events related to task status mismatches to address the out-of-control reviewConcerns pattern.

slices.title: Patch defect event logging for task status mismatches
slices.jtbd: When implementing the defect logging patch for this epic, I want to assign a rootCausePatternId to underlying defect events, so that status mismatch defects are categorized to help ensure tasks are not falsely marked as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an uncategorized defect event for a task status mismatch,
When the system logs the event,
Then it is assigned a valid rootCausePatternId.
Given the patched logging logic,
When automated tests run,
Then they pass and assert the expected rootCausePatternId is properly assigned.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of uncategorized task status mismatch defect events from 100% to 0%
